caveats: Apple's App Store page lists every in-app purchase price point it has on file, including historical and A/B-tested tiers; the lists in 'inAppPurchases_asListedByApple' are therefore NOT the single current price. Where a current price is asserted in the write-up it is sourced separately and cited.
The customer-reviews RSS feed returns a capped, US-only sample (max ~10 pages x 50), so review counts and distributions here are samples, not true distributions.
Agape and Cupla returned zero reviews from the feed on the date observed.
Feature and convention counts come from grepping App Store description text. They undercount: an app can ship a feature without advertising it in those words. Read them as floors.
No app was installed. Except for review quotes, all behaviour claims are developer copy.
Dominant-colour values are median-cut quantisations of the 512px icon and the first three screenshots; they characterise the artwork, not a declared brand palette.
